# Prompts queued for a pane, and what its composer had in it, come back with
# the pane when Libertty restarts (a quit, an update) and liberttyd keeps the
# pane (--persist), kept meanwhile in a file of the data folder private to
# you. The queue comes back paused, and says why, until you resume it.
type:sleep 30
key:enter
wait:0.5
queue-prompt:echo FIRST-$((40+2))
queue-prompt:echo SECOND-$((50+5))
key:cmd+shift+e
type:my draft
key:escape
expect-composer:closed
expect-queue:2
expect-queue:running
restart-prompts:go
expect-shell:stat -f %Lp "$LIBERTTY_DATA_DIR/prompt-queues.json" ==> 600
expect-queue:order=echo FIRST-$((40+2))|echo SECOND-$((50+5))
expect-queue:paused
expect-queue:tag=2 queued · paused
expect-composer:text=my draft
# Back at the prompt, it still waits for you…
key:ctrl+c
wait:2.0
expect-not:FIRST-42
# …until you resume it.
composer:queue
click:The queue is paused: Libertty restarted since these were queued. Resume
expect-queue:running
wait:2.5
expect:FIRST-42
